description: Source code for the Emergency Access Daemon (ead), implementing network packet handling, authentication, and command execution over UDP using libpcap, with bridge and interface management.

methods.name: ead_open_pcap
methods.description: Creates and configures a pcap handle for a given network interface, with optional receive mode.

methods.name: prepare_password
methods.description: Prepares user password and cryptographic parameters for authentication based on the password file.

methods.name: set_recv_type
methods.description: Configures the receive type for a pcap handle on Linux.

methods.name: ead_send_packet_clone
methods.description: Clones and sends a network packet, adjusting IP and UDP headers.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Transitions the internal state machine of the daemon.

methods.name: handle_ping
methods.description: Handles ping messages, responding with a pong.

methods.name: handle_set_username
methods.description: Processes a request to set the username for authentication.

methods.name: handle_get_prime
methods.description: Handles request to send cryptographic prime and salt for key exchange.

methods.name: handle_send_a
methods.description: Handles reception of the 'A' value in Diffie-Hellman key exchange.

methods.name: handle_send_auth
methods.description: Verifies client authentication and responds accordingly.

methods.name: handle_send_cmd
methods.description: Executes commands received from the client, possibly in background or stream mode.

methods.name: parse_message
methods.description: Parses incoming messages and dispatches to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: handle_packet
methods.description: Processes captured network packets, filtering and passing valid packets to message parser.

methods.name: ead_pcap_reopen
methods.description: Reopens pcap handles, applying filters and handling interface/bridge changes.

methods.name: ead_pktloop
methods.description: Main packet processing loop using pcap_dispatch.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the daemon.

methods.name: server_handle_sigchld
methods.description: Handles SIGCHLD signals to clean up child processes.

methods.name: instance_handle_sigchld
methods.description: Handles SIGCHLD for child process termination.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts a network interface server, forking if necessary.

methods.name: start_servers
methods.description: Starts all configured server instances.

methods.name: stop_server
methods.description: Stops a server instance and optionally frees resources.

methods.name: server_handle_sigint
methods.description: Handles SIGINT to terminate all server instances.

methods.name: check_bridge_port
methods.description: Associates network ports with bridges.

methods.name: check_bridge
methods.description: Iterates over bridge ports to assign interfaces.

methods.name: check_all_interfaces
methods.description: Checks and updates interface-bridge associations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, initializes and runs the Emergency Access Daemon.
